messages:
anita: Quick flag 5: we're scheduling an emergency keystore rotation for alias/customer-data-prod next Tue 04:00 UTC. Need DSAR-proofing checklist.
raj: Thanks. Major risk is decrypt window for archived proofs. If jobs hit decrypt-denied during rotation we could miss legal SLOs.
jen: Can we give the DSAR runner a scoped, timebound decrypt role for the maintenance window? Prefer ephemeral role with strict conditions.
mike: We need to export any proofs that are in-flight or scheduled inside the 6h pre-window. I'll create a list of dsar ids and object paths.
sara: Legal wants explicit auditability: every proof manifest must include kms_request_id and a rotation_reason string. Also retention-exception items must be excluded from any export or deletion steps.
raj: Keystore-proxy returns header X-KMS-Request-Id on success. We'll plumb that into the deletion-service manifest field `kms_request_id`. Also will emit structured log: `keystore.decrypt_ok {principal, object_id, kms_request_id}`.
jen: IAM plan: create role `dsar-temp-decrypt-<ts>` with policy only allowing `keystore:Decrypt` for `alias/customer-data-prod` and tag `rotation-safe-window=true`. Use STS Session with max duration 1h. Auto-revoke after 90 minutes.
mike: I'll add filter in export job: `if retention_exception == true then skip` and `if proof_state in [in_progress, pending_retry] include`. Export target `s3://redwood-dsar-exports/pre-1823456789/`.
sara: Also legal requests a signed statement we attempted export before rotation in case of dispute. Can we store a signed manifest with Cloud KMS signing key?
raj: We can sign the manifest using platform-signing-service; it already stamps `manifest_signature` for other legal artifacts. I'll wire that into the export step.
jen: Alerting: add a temporary rule for decrypt-denied spikes during the window: `keystore.decrypt_denied > 3 in 5m` -> page eng-oncall + privacy oncall. Include runbook link.
anita: Good. What about vuln triage if rotation fails or old keys show unauthorized use? We need an IR path.
raj: Triage plan: if unexpected `keystore.decrypt_ok` from service accounts that shouldn't have access appears, escalate to sec-incident channel, rotate affected key material immediately, and run an access audit for last 24h.
mike: Dev work: need to change deletion-service to attach `kms_request_id` and `manifest_signature` to the DSAR evidence bundle. ETA 3h, small patch.
sara: Legal ok with the 1h ephemeral grant and export approach, provided we post the timeline and keep privacy team in the loop.
jen: Canaries: run 10 randomized decrypts against archived blobs before revoking old key access. Script: `for k in $(shuf -n10 canary_ids.txt); do curl -sS keystore-proxy/decrypt?obj=$k || echo FAIL:$k; done`. Failures abort rotation.
raj: Runbook draft steps: 1) identify proofs to export (mike), 2) export + sign manifest (mike, raj), 3) create ephemeral IAM role (jen), 4) run canary decrypts (raj), 5) perform rotation (keystore team), 6) monitor decrypt_ok/deny for 1h (raj), 7) revoke ephemeral role (jen), 8) post-rotation reconciliation & upload signed evidence (mike), 9) inform legal & privacy (sara).
anita: For retention exceptions: ensure export job queries the retention table and excludes `legal_hold=true`. Also mark any skipped dsar ids in the signed manifest with `skipped_due_to_retention_exception`.
jen: I'll include IAM event CloudTrail retention for 90 days and snapshot the policy change (s3://redwood-iam-backups/).
mike: I'll add a manifest line example: `{\"dsar_id\":\"dsar_123\",\"object\":\"s3://...\",\"kms_request_id\":\"abcd-1234\",\"manifest_signature\":\"sig..\",\"skipped_due_to_retention_exception\":false}`
sara: Also require the audit reason text: `rotation_reason: \"scheduled rotation - safety window for DSAR proofs\"` in the signed manifest.
privacy-bot: DSAR runbook update: required fields in evidence bundle: dsar_id, requestor_email, kms_request_id, manifest_signature, rotation_reason, legal_ticket.
raj: Who's owning the pager threshold? I'll propose eng-sre owns initial page, privacy oncall as second.
anita: I'll draft the incident checklist for vuln/rotation failure: immediate revoke, rotate all derived keys, contact customers if scope > 1 tenant, open sec-incident ticket.
jen: After rotation, run reconciliation job to re-run any proofs that were exported and confirm `kms_request_id` match the manifest. Any mismatches create an audit ticket for legal.
mike: I'll file the pre-rotation ticket and tag @eng-oncall and @privacy for the window. ETA to be live by EOD.
sara: Legal signed off contingent on manifest_signature and the retention-exception safeguard. No blockers from our side.
raj: Great. I'll finalize runbook and schedule a pre-rotation smoke at T-minus 2h. Post here when ticket is up.
anita: Thx everyone.
